stories.title: Election Integrity or Ballot Sabotage? Supreme Court Green-Lights Trump's Mail-Voting Order
stories.conservative_headline: SCOTUS Sides With Trump: Court Clears Path to Secure Mail Ballots Before November
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Hands Trump Power Over Who Gets a Ballot — Jackson Warns of 'Chaos'
stories.poll_question: Should Trump's executive order restricting mail-in voting take effect before the midterms?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Federal standards on mail ballots protect elections from fraud and error.
stories.poll_option2_desc: A president rewriting ballot rules weeks before an election is unconstitutional.

stories.title: Tough Trade or Grocery-Bill Bomb? Trump Slaps 50% Tariff on Canadian Autos and Steel

stories.poll_option2_desc: Tariffs are a hidden tax paid by families at the dealership.
